content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of Duran Duran whose rock edge helped drive the band's biggest hits, has died at 65. He died Monday, November 23, at home after a long battle with metastatic prostate cancer.

Taylor's guitar work helped power Duran Duran's rise to worldwide fame, driving hits including 'Rio' and 'Hungry Like the Wolf.' His rock edge gave the band a harder, guitar-driven sound that helped set it apart.

Taylor's passing marks the loss of one of the defining voices of 1980s rock, and fans around the world are remembering the music he helped create.
